sanskrit: svamahimnā'nādyudayo'nāyatto namo namastasmaivakṣye jñātaṃ guruto hitakṛtaye mandabuddhīnāmsupte'pi vikṛtijāte tritayaṃ jāgarti tattvānāmsaṃgṛhīte'pi jāgarti prakāśata evaekaṃ prasavitvayutaṃ māyātattvaṃ citā vihīnaṃ cakāryaprasavayuktaṃ mṛdādivadacetanaṃ camukteśvaravaimalyaṃ sarvārthe dṛkkriye ca tataḥtadapreryatvāt tenaiva parānugrahanirvāhācca na pravartantesakalākalaprabhedo gīto yaśca kriyāviṣayaḥdīkṣayā | vijñeyaḥ sa tridhāvasthaḥ kevalaḥ sakalo'malaḥ || itiekena hi sarveṣāṃ malena tadanādisaṃruddhamna saṃbhavati | taduktaṃ śrīmatsvāyambhuve- athānādimalaḥ puṃsām (33|1) itina ca śaktāste svabalaṃ vimalaṃ sarvārthagaṃ svataḥ kartumdīkṣākhyenaiveti | etacca vistareṇoktamasmābhistattvasaṃgrahalaghuṭīkāyāmpatyustvete rodhyā badhyāḥ śodhyāśca bodhyāścaprabodhyāśca bhavantisatyaṃ nānyā dṛk tat tādṛg yasmāt tadīśvare dṛṣṭamvikāritvenācetanatvādanityatvādidoṣaprasaṅgaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥmalaśaktayo vibhinnāḥ pratyātmānaṃ ca tadguṇāvarikāḥbhāvaḥpariṇativiśeṣayogāt sa kadācit kasyacit kathañciccapadmānāmivā'niyatakāla ityāha- pariṇativiśeṣa itikālād guṇataśca tathā ghaṭate'sau nānyatheśato jātubhavati, pakṣapātādidoṣaprasaṅgāt | na cāsya sarvānugrāhakasya pakṣapātaḥsadyuktimad vimuktau netarathā sādhanānantyam

sanskrit: tasya tathā tāvadbhirnihitairvijahāti bandhatvamnihitaiḥ sadbhirbandhatvaṃ vijahātiśārve śāstre tāni ca netarathā yuktimanti jāyantebījād dadāti citryaṃ niṣkṛṣya ca yaḥ sasādhanaṃ bhogamśuddhe'dhvani śivaḥ kartā prokto'nanto'site prabhuḥ (vi0 3|27) itiviśvaṃ ca tatra nihitaṃ pralaye tenaiva viśrāntyaitathāvidhāṃścātmanaḥ punarbhogayogyān vidhattesamalaṃ sa mahābaladaḥ kāruṇyāt sarvadaiva vinivṛttyaipuṃbalarodhaṃ kurvan dṛṣṭaḥ sa ca pāśaśaktisāhāyyambījasyeva svāpe pariṇatiriṣṭā malasya citihāneḥsarvātmasu no yugapat kuryāditi codayan vācyaḥna samādhiranekatvāt kālāntarabhogyatābalīyastvamce, tadetatsamādhānaṃ na yuktamityāha- na samādhiritiīśe bīje ca yato bhavini vibhutvaṃ ca bhoktṛbhāvaścabījād yugapat puruṣaṃ bhojayati sarvakarmāṇipācayati tathaiva śambhustānīti samānamubhayatrasamānamitiśaknoti hi yogyatvaṃ tathaiva kartuṃ maheśvaro'pītikuryānna yugapadityanumīyata ityarthaḥbhavatottaramabhidheyaṃ sthitisamaye samānakālīnepāka eva | śeṣaṃ sugamamyāvati kāle bhavati taddhi tathā tāvadīśenaityāha- idaṃ tulyamitialamuddiṣṭamaśuddheḥ sadrūpaṃ niravaśeṣeṇaśaktyānantyapramukhaṃ sadyukteḥ śāsanotthāyāḥ
